key.name: shortcut-key
key.summary: Keyboard shortcut to open launcher search
key.description: Global keybinding to open GNOME search (recommended: ["<Control><Super>space"])

key.name: search-engine-url
key.description: URL opened for the web-search fallback. %s is replaced with the URL-encoded query, e.g. https://duckduckgo.com/?q=%s, https://noai.duckduckgo.com/?q=%s, https://www.google.com/search?q=%s, or https://www.google.com/search?q=%s&udm=web (the &udm=web disables AI Overviews; by default it is not present, so AI overviews will be shown)

key.name: search-placeholder-text
key.summary: Placeholder text for the launcher search box
key.description: Hint text shown in the launcher search box when no query has been typed, e.g., "Type to search..." or "Spotlight Search".

key.name: selection-color
key.description: CSS color used as the background of the highlighted result row.

key.name: show-panel-icon
key.summary: Show search icon in the top panel
key.description: Adds a search icon to the right of the top panel that opens the launcher when clicked.

key.name: show-entry-icon
key.summary: Show search icon in the launcher
key.description: Show the magnifying glass icon next to the launcher search box.

key.name: entry-icon-size
key.description: Pixel size of the magnifying glass drawn inside the launcher search box.

key.name: fuzzy-level
key.description: How strictly a query has to match a name, ignoring case. If it's off, it will be substring matches only. If it's balanced, then the first letter must match a word in the title, and far matches (like "vsc" -> "Visual Studio Code") won't come up. If it's loose, then as long as the characters in the query appear in the same order in the app name/file path, even if they are far apart, it will match. So, if you type "dj879", "~/Documents/Clients/John-Doe/IRS-Form-8879.pdf" WILL come up.
